_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-10-30 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today); anything already past its activeUntil at cataloguing time was skipped rather than included pre-expired. New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.

special_badges.note: Check in any one (1) pumpkin/yam beer in the window - matches had_it_index's own 'style' field, same convention as the permanent 'Gourd to the Last Drop' style badge which uses the identical 'Pumpkin / Yam' catalog style.

Check in any one (1) beer in any Stout style/category in the window - post lists ~20 Stout - * leaf styles as eligible (American, Belgian, Coffee, English, Foreign/Export, Imperial/Double and its Coffee/Milk/Oatmeal/Pastry/White-Golden variants, Irish Dry, Milk/Sweet, Oatmeal, Other, Oyster, Pastry, Russian Imperial, Smoked, White/Golden), i.e. the whole umbrella category - using the bare substring matcher 'Stout' (per _split_style_matchers' documented umbrella-entry convention) covers all of them without hand-enumerating every leaf.
